notes: ACS estimates are survey-based and carry margins of error that are not retrieved here; differences between geographies may not be statistically distinguishable.
Jam values (suppressed / unavailable estimates) were converted to missing. Sentinels recognised: [-999999999, -888888888, -777777777, -666666666, -555555555, -333333333, -222222222, -111111111].
5-year estimates are period estimates, not point-in-time measures.
